interpretation.experiment_type: native-gate noiseless classical statevector execution plus simulated independent measurement counts
interpretation.inference_bias: MLAE estimates the same compiled prepared-state probability; additional shots do not remove model, spatial, or product-formula bias
interpretation.synthesis_error: prospective rotation implementation error is separately budgeted over repeated gate occurrences
interpretation.classical_dominance_scope: this small materialized finite-grid workload; not an asymptotic high-dimensional theorem
interpretation.continuum_vs_grid: ODE samples are quantized to nearest periodic grid nodes; coarse-grid Born masses are only approximations to those cell probabilities
